THE SQUOZEN TRUTH (MECH-COGNITIVE DUALITY THEOREM):
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Let M be a language model with parameter manifold Theta and vocabulary V.
Structural constraints (markdown fences, syntax balance, grammar, no-chatter) 
occupy high-entropy boundary basins in the generation simplex Delta^|V|.

1. Training Theta to avoid these basins (via RLHF/DPO) compresses semantic representation,
   steals attention heads, and remains probabilistic: P(leakage) > 0.
2. Erecting an infinite potential barrier V(x) -> +inf (logits processor score -> -inf)
   at the boundary mechanically guarantees P(leakage) = 0.00%.
3. By the Conservation of Cognitive Bandwidth, removing structural policing from Theta
   maximizes the Fisher Information Metric of the model weights on semantic reasoning.
CONCLUSION: Mechanism governs structure; Neural weights govern meaning.
